queue.what: Family-owned national 3PL with 46 facilities across the U.S. and a private truck fleet, offering e-commerce, retail and subscription fulfillment plus transportation.
Tennessee-based 3PL with more than 90 distribution centers across the U.S. and Canada, offering B2B and D2C e-commerce fulfillment alongside warehousing and transportation management.
Los Angeles-based fulfillment technology platform that gives brands access to a nationwide network of warehouses, and has raised roughly $46M or more in funding.
E-commerce 3PL with a nationwide U.S. warehouse network for 1-2 day ground delivery, formerly Rakuten Super Logistics and earlier Webgistix.
Brooklyn-based warehouse management software vendor for e-commerce brands and 3PLs, serving thousands of warehouses and carrying a large share of U.S. e-commerce parcel shipments.
